title: Finding royalty free sound effects by either buying them outright (No subscription) or simply acquiring them for free?
author: No_Departure7494
selftext: Where do you guys get your audio from? I refuse to buy from a site that forces me to stay subscribed in order to use it for commercial purposes. Free stuff is really hit or miss, usually miss.

comments.author: InsolentCoolRadio
comments.body:
You can use Fal

They have a ton of different models to choose from and it’s pay as you go

comments.author: FragmentedHeap
comments.body:
MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0, runs locally on a 24 gb gpu easily, sounds good.

Online Demo here: [https://huggingface.co/spaces/OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-SoundEffect-v2.0](https://huggingface.co/spaces/OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-SoundEffect-v2.0)

You can use it commercially, no royalties, no revenue cap nada, just go.

I made a little studio for it I use locally, and other local llm models that are unrestrictive, and I can layer pieces of sound effects from these and make new effects etc.

Like I have a laser gun that has 10 levels and overheats, made all that with AI.

Theres many other AI.

You can use Minimax h3 too and you can email them for a commercial license and they just give it to you, it's just a liability waiver.

comments.author: DimensionalFukery
comments.body:
For some sound effect types you can get ai to write sounds files in CSound. It's basically a programming language for sounds. 

Works well for simple stuff and even basic beats.

comments.author: discomonk
comments.body: I just had Claude generate a DAW it can work in, which gives me as much audio as I want, licence free and I own the copyright (UK-based, laws may differ)

comments.author: Duneagames
comments.body:
Stable Audio Large model has been decent enough for me.. occasionally it gives me something weird with weird audio artifacts, but with Elevenlabs i get that too. 

If they cant get me what im looking for, i just rip sfx off of yt or freesound and do post-processing in Audacity.

comments.author: azzaisme
comments.body: My Claude seems to have a disposition towards Kenney's free sounds. It never looks anywhere else

comments.author: Empuda
comments.body: Try to ask Gemini on their website. Does some interesting things.

comments.author: Horror-Detective4138
comments.body: I get astra to search the web for sounds and have it recreate them in a soft synth (I use pigments) for full control of the sound.
